options.cookeymod.animations.swingAndUse: If on, the swinging animation will not be cancelled when you start interacting with an item.
options.cookeymod.animations.enableOldSw: Brings back the old swinging animation from 1.16.
options.cookeymod.animations.sneakAnimat: Changes the speed of the transition when your eye level changes (for example, when sneaking).
options.cookeymod.animations.disableCame: When "View bobbing" is on, this will disable the camera shake when walking while keeping the arm animation. Note that this option §4does not work with shaders enabled§r in Iris due to changes made in that mod.
options.cookeymod.animations.enableToolB: Enables a blocking animation on your tools when blocking with a shield similar to the 1.8 sword block.
options.cookeymod.animations.showEatingI: Enables an eating & drinking animation in 3rd person.
options.cookeymod.animations.enableDamag: Makes your camera tilt into the direction of your knockback when attacked.
options.cookeymod.hudRendering.attackCoo: Changes how far your weapon goes down in 1st person when it is recharging.
options.cookeymod.hudRendering.damageCol: Changes the color of the damage tint on entites.
options.cookeymod.hudRendering.showDamag: Makes the damage tint also appear on armor. Can also enable the tint on trims.
Makes the damage tint also appear on held items in 3rd person. This option §4might not work§r with custom resource packs which override item shaders.
Makes the damage tint also appear on capes.
Makes the damage tint also appear in first person, either just on hands or also on items. This option §4might not work §rwith custom resource packs which override item shaders.
options.cookeymod.hudRendering.onlyShowS: Hides the shield in 1st person when it is not used.
options.cookeymod.hudRendering.disableEf: Ignores changes in the FOV caused by potion effects (sprinting FOV is unaffected by this).
options.cookeymod.hudRendering.showHandW: Show hand in 1st person when you are invisible.
options.cookeymod.hudRendering.firstPers: Changes the opacity of the hand in first person when "Show hand when invisible" is on and the player is invisible.
options.cookeymod.misc.showModButton.too: Changes whether the CookeyMod button should be shown in the options menu of Minecraft.
options.cookeymod.misc.showOwnNameInThir: Makes your own name appear over your player in 3rd person.
options.cookeymod.misc.force100PercentRe: Forces you to always recharge 100% of the weapon cooldown after missing. This might be helpful for improving your aim and timing in the Combat Tests.
options.cookeymod.misc.fixLocalPlayerHan: Fixes a bug in the client that causes particles to appear and that cancels your sprint even when a hit has been cancelled when attacking a player. (See MC-211708)
options.cookeymod.misc.fixCooldownDesync: Fixing the attack cooldown on the client being desynchronized in some cases when breaking or placing blocks or when dropping items. (See MC-218570)
